item.title: Sir Lenny Henry Centre leads UK-wide student conversation on BBC Charter Renewal
item.description: The Sir Lenny Henry Centre for Media Diversity (LHC) is leading a major UK-wide initiative to bring student voices into the national debate on BBC Charter Renewal - at a critical moment for the broadcaster’s future and its relationship with young audiences.

item.title: BCU in Top 10 for Social Mobility
item.description: Birmingham City University (BCU) has been named in the top 10 higher education providers for social mobility in the English Social Mobility Index. The latest results, compiled by London South Bank University (LSBU) and published by the Higher Education Policy Institute (HEPI) shows that BCU is seventh out of 100 universities in the rankings, rising one place since 2024.
